description:
GuardExtern::new (src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs) admits float returns and Checked returns; guard operators resolve as calls to the same Kernel functions bodies use; a Checked failure in a guard is the clause not matching. The raw guard arithmetic is deleted from ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs, native_codegen/prim.rs and receive.rs.

Fails before, passes after, three paths: 'rem(n, 0) == 1', 'n + 1 > 0' at maxint, 'n / 0' and a guard using a user-shadowed + answer as Elixir does (clause does not match; the shadow is called).

Re-pins (in the page's must-change list): fixture 00622, source_test, pattern_test.

Removed: the second arithmetic implementation.

Acceptance: full gate green; the 85-probe guard census matches the page's 'after' column.

Folded in from fz-rs7.3 (the two cannot land apart): a test the lane decides emits only its live edge. Once guard operators resolve as Kernel calls, a guard over a mixed-lane subject dispatches on the operand's kind, and the walkers emit both successors of a test the operand's lane already decides. The dead successor reads the operand in the wrong lane and cannot be lowered: 184 of the 296 mixed-lane guard programs (gh-303-spikes/matrix.py) fail to compile. The spike papered over this by making as_raw_i64, as_raw_f64, receive_value_int and receive_value_float return zero for a wrong lane; on develop all four refuse a wrong lane (error or panic) and must keep refusing. So: emit_runtime_type_test (runtime_test.rs), which already answers a test on an unboxed lane with a constant, returns a three-way answer (always, never, a runtime flag), and the two walkers (lower_dispatch_test in native.rs; emit_guard_dispatch_node in receive.rs) emit only the live successor.

On develop before this ticket the matrix has no dead-edge failure to show: guard arithmetic is a raw machine op, 275 of the 296 differ from Elixir for arithmetic reasons (96 refused 'guards cannot call extern fz_op_div_ii/fz_op_rem_ii', 75 abort in fz_ref_load_int on run and build, 32 fail to compile with 'expected int receive value', float entry guards answered wrongly by interp). Base measurements: scratch trs7b/fz-rs7.3/base/base.json.

Acceptance adds: all 296 match Elixir on three paths, as ONE generated matrix test with Elixir's answers captured once in a checked-in table (regenerated with elixir through matrix.py); the four lane readers still refuse a wrong lane; 'n * 2 == 3' sent 1.5 in a receive answers :a on three paths (on develop interp and the entry guard answer :b and the JIT receive aborts in fz_unbox_int).
title: Guards carry numbers and declared failures
